mentions.name: ArtCraft (Craft Apps)
mentions.description: ArtCraft and the Craft Apps are a fully open source suite spanning software, SaaS, infrastructure, model weights, platforms, and protocols. The project bridges local and cloud compute seamlessly, provides an app factory for high-throughput development, and includes reverse engineering tools for non-technical people. It publishes high-quality libraries others can remix, all built to be agentic and AI/CLI first class, aiming to make the world hacker-first again like Web 1.0 with P2P, RSS, APIs, and IRC.
mentions.problem: The world is no longer hacker-first like the Web 1.0 era of P2P, RSS, APIs, and IRC.
mentions.audience: Non-technical people (via reverse engineering tools) and a hacker-first community.

ArtCraft and the Craft Apps.

We're building an app factory for high throughout development. Reverse engineering tools for non-technical people. We're going to make high quality libraries that others can remix.

We're going to make all of this agentic and AI/CLI first class.
